decision_rule.adaptive_dense_gate: if low rank fails and either side has median cosine <0.50, the conjugated basis must be latent/task-adaptive rather than a static fitted basis
decision_rule.low_rank_gate: both sides must fit their all-budget direct skew rank caps in every layer; this is deliberately generous because a real bilateral budget split is stricter
decision_rule.stable_dense_gate: if low rank fails but both generator sides have median cross-window cosine >=0.50, test a fixed global FHT-conjugated dense tangent basis next

fixed_protocol.spectrum: exact nonzero singular values of the coupled skew generators; the 3072-square left generator is represented exactly in a <=1536 compressed orthonormal basis; singular-gap conditioning is recorded
fixed_protocol.stability: Frobenius cosine from the reference generator to three independent fixed task-gradient windows, using exact compact inner products

limitations: This is a zero-update local geometry diagnostic, not language-model training.
Cross-window stability is measured at one terminal checkpoint and includes the persisted Muon momentum state; it is not cross-checkpoint or cross-seed solution-manifold evidence.
A favorable singular spectrum is only an oracle capacity condition. Any production factorization still needs a separate held-out CE tangent gate and >=20% host-local measured MFU.
No learned basis, LoRA, dense residual adapter, channel gain, radial parameter, optimizer update, or model update is introduced.
question: Are the exact bilateral c_fc skew generators low-rank and stable enough for a direct compact factorization, or do they require a dense conjugated orthogonal basis?
